title: Amartha 10X Run 2026 Review: What the 2026 Race Was Like
seo_title: Amartha 10X Run 2026 Review: GBK Course, Heat, Cut-offs
meta_description: Amartha 10X Run 2026 review: 10K and half marathon from GBK up Sudirman to Bundaran HI, 25°C at the 5am start, water every 2 km, a 15.8 km cut-off and a 1:11:32 winning half.
dek: What the 2026 Amartha 10X Run in Jakarta was actually like: the route from GBK to Bundaran HI and Prapanca, the weather from the 5am start, the aid and cut-offs, how fast the field ran, and the race village at the finish.
verdict: Enter if you want a well-supported 10K or half marathon in central Jakarta with a festival finish. The 2026 race started at GBK at 5am in 25°C air with a dew point of 20°C, took both distances up Sudirman to Bundaran HI, and put water every 2 km on the half. The front of the field is quick, with a 1:11:32 winning half, but the median half marathoner took about two and a half hours. The catch is the clock. It was 29°C by 8am and 31°C by the 9am cut-off, the half has a 15.8 km checkpoint that closed at 8.12am, and 104 runners in the 10K finished outside its two-hour limit. Pace for the heat.

sections.heading: The Course: Sudirman to Bundaran HI and Back
paragraphs: Both races started and finished on Jalan Apec beside Plaza Parkir Timur at Gelora Bung Karno (GBK) [1]. The 10K is simple: out through Pintu 7 onto Jalan Jenderal Sudirman, up to Bundaran HI at about 4 km on the map, then back down Sudirman to Bundaran Senayan and back to GBK [1].

The half marathon starts the same way, up Sudirman to Bundaran HI and back [1]. It then turns into Jalan Senopati and Jalan Pattimura, through the Pattimura underpass and along Iskandarsyah Raya, Sultan Hasanuddin and Prapanca Raya to a U-turn at Brawijaya, the southern end of the course at about 13 km on the map [1]. It comes back the same way to Bundaran Senayan, runs an out-and-back along Jalan Sisingamangaraja to a U-turn at Asean, and returns up Sudirman to the finish [1].

Check the race book rather than the website for the route. The route text on the race-info page is an older version, with a U-turn before Bundaran HI and no Prapanca section [2]; the race book, updated on 3 September, has the route above [1].

sections.heading: The Weather: 25°C at the Start, 31°C by the Cut-off
paragraphs: Jakarta's Halim airport, about 11 km east-south-east of GBK, recorded 25°C at the 5am start, with a dew point of 20°C, 74% humidity and a 3-knot wind [3]. At 5.30am it was 24°C and calm. It then warmed quickly: 26°C at 7am, 29°C at 8am and 31°C at 9am, when the half marathon closed, with humidity falling to 46% [3].

A dew point of 20°C is sticky, but sweat still evaporates far better than on the 24°C to 25°C mornings common at tropical races. The heat is the problem, not the humidity. A 10K runner finishing by 6.30am ran in about 24°C to 26°C; a half marathoner still out after 8am ran the last kilometres at 29°C to 31°C. The race director said water stations were set every 2 km instead of every 5 km because Jakarta is hot [4].

sections.heading: Aid Stations and Cut-offs
paragraphs: On the half-marathon map there is a water station every 2 km, from 2 km to 20 km, with a fruit station at 10 km, a sponge station at 13 km, a gel station near 14 km and a shower station at 19 km [1]. The 10K has water at 2, 4, 6 and 8 km [1]. The organiser promised 10 water stations and fruit stations, medics every 2 km, eight ambulances with defibrillators and a marshal every 100 m, especially at junctions [5]. Along with water, the stations handed out sponsors' snacks, from nuggets and sweets to cheese, bagels, fried chicken and orange juice [6].

The half marathon has a four-hour limit, with the last finish at 9am, and one intermediate cut-off: 15.8 km within 3:02:01, at 8.12am [1]. The 10K has a two-hour limit, with the last finish at 7.20am [1]. Finishers outside the limit do not get a medal [1]. In 2026, 104 runners in the 10K, 44 men and 60 women, are listed as over the limit, with gun times beyond two hours [7]. Every half-marathon finisher in the results came in under four hours; the slowest took 3:59:47 [7].

sections.heading: On the Day: Organisation
paragraphs: The gates opened at 4am, with a safety briefing at 4.40am [1]. The half-marathon start pen closed at 5.10am and the 10K pen at 5.40am [1], and anyone starting before the flag-off is disqualified [8]. The results list 29 disqualifications in the 10K and four in the half [7]; no reason is given.

A post-race write-up on Presscorner said race-pack collection was orderly, race information was clear and the flag-offs were on time, with marshals and medics spread along the route [9]. The organiser also arranged for local women to cheer along the course, a nod to the women-run village businesses that Amartha lends to [10].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The half marathon was won by Rikki Marthin Luther Simbolon in 1:11:32, four seconds ahead of Nofeldi Petingko and Sedilta Pilon Nubatonis, both given 1:11:36 [7]; Nubatonis, a marine, was credited with third [11]. Isania Tarigan won the women's race in 1:26:29, from Anjellika Br Ginting in 1:28:19 and Eva Desiana in 1:29:59 [7]. These are gun times; the winner's net time was 1:11:27 [7].

Tenth place, counting all ages, was 1:21:46 for men and 1:48:28 for women, and the median half marathoner took 2:28:17 (men) and 2:53:01 (women) [7]. In the 10K, Anggiat Sihombing won in 32:47 and Binta Erlen Salsabela in 40:30; tenth places were 43:42 and 49:50, and the medians 1:20:06 and 1:32:01 [7].

Prizes go three deep in open (National) and Master categories. The half pays Rp14 million, Rp10 million and Rp6 million, and Rp8 million to the Master winners; the 10K pays Rp7 million, Rp5 million and Rp3 million, and Rp4 million to the Master winners [2]. The total prize fund was Rp200 million [12]. Five Master women finished in the women's 10K top ten, and tenth place was 49:50 [7], so a Master podium is within reach of a good club runner.

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Race packs were collected on 4 and 5 September, 10am to 8pm, at Lippo Mall Nusantara on Jalan Sudirman [1]. Collection is compulsory: if nobody collects your pack, you lose your place [1]. A representative can collect for up to five runners with a signed letter of authorisation [1]. The pack had a jersey, string bag, bib and insurance, plus a finisher jersey for half marathoners [12].

On race morning a free Bluebird shuttle ran from 4am, from Amartha Village via Liberta Hotel Kemang and Liberta Hub Blok M to GBK Arena, and Bluebird offered 20% off rides with a promo code [1]. Bag drop opened at 4am and closed at 9am; bags not collected by 11am are the runner's own risk [1]. Children, strollers and pets are not allowed in the race [1].

After the finish, the village-themed race village had games, free fruit, vegetables and betta fish, and a market of the small businesses Amartha lends to [6]. Medal engraving was free [9]. The minister for youth and sports, Erick Thohir, attended in 2026 [6].

Normal-price entry was Rp650,000 for the half and Rp450,000 for the 10K [2]; the early-bird price ran from 15 to 21 May 2026 [8]. Entries cannot be refunded [1] or transferred [8], and the minimum age is 17 [8].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a 10K or half marathon through central Jakarta with dense aid, a 5am start and a finish area that is more festival than finish pen. The 10K suits newer runners who can finish inside two hours.

Think twice if you are a slower half marathoner: the 15.8 km cut-off at 8.12am and the heat after 8am are the real test. If you expect to be close to three hours for the half, practise in the heat and check the cut-off point in the race book.
No date, route or fees for 2027 had been published when this was written.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's race information and race book, the official results, airport weather records, and Indonesian news and press coverage.

faqs.question: What time does the Amartha 10X Run start?
faqs.answer: Early. In 2026 the half marathon started at 5am and the 10K at 5.20am, from Jalan Apec beside Plaza Parkir Timur at GBK. The gates opened at 4am, and the start pens closed at 5.10am for the half and 5.40am for the 10K. Bag drop opened at 4am, and a free shuttle ran from 4am.

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times at the Amartha 10X Run?
faqs.answer: Four hours for the half marathon, with the last finish at 9am and an intermediate cut-off at 15.8 km at 8.12am. Two hours for the 10K, with the last finish at 7.20am. Runners outside the limit get no medal; in 2026, 104 runners in the 10K finished over two hours.

faqs.question: How hot is the Amartha 10X Run?
faqs.answer: Warm and getting hotter. At the 5am start in 2026, Jakarta's Halim airport recorded 25°C, a dew point of 20°C and 74% humidity. It was 29°C by 8am and 31°C by 9am, when the half marathon closed. Runners who finish early get the coolest air, so the 10K is the easier race for heat.

faqs.question: How many water stations does the Amartha 10X Run have?
faqs.answer: Plenty. In 2026 the half marathon had water every 2 km, from 2 km to 20 km, plus fruit at 10 km, sponges at 13 km, gel near 14 km and a shower at 19 km. The 10K had water at 2, 4, 6 and 8 km. Stations also handed out sponsors' snacks, including fried chicken and orange juice.

faqs.question: How fast do you need to be to place at the Amartha 10X Run?
faqs.answer: Fast in the open races, less so in Master. In 2026 the half marathon was won in 1:11:32 and 1:26:29, and the 10K in 32:47 and 40:30, all gun times. Tenth place in the women's 10K was 49:50. Prizes go three deep in both open and Master categories, up to Rp14 million.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-29 about the 2026 edition, run on 6 September. Replaces a thinner review built on one report. The route is taken from the official race book (updated 3 September), which differs from the older route text on the race-info page; the difference is stated. Aid-station positions are read from the race-book maps. Results are gun times from the timing provider's public results page; 10th places are counted across National and Master categories. Reports say about 5,000 runners; the results list 3,860, and both are given. Weather is from Halim airport METARs, 11 km from the start; there was no 6am or 6.30am observation. No independent runner accounts could be found; most coverage repeats the organiser's release, and Presscorner's organisation claims are attributed to it. No rating.
